artworks.title: Three Hunters and Two Dogs near a Pool
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image depicts a forest scene with dense foliage and trees, rays of light filtering through the canopy, textured brushstrokes or etchings, a monochromatic color palette of gray and black, fallen trees with exposed roots, and a distant opening with a figure emerging. In the background, there are undulating clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Inn to the Right and House on Rocks to the Left
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene of a rugged landscape with buildings scattered across it. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, allowing an expansive view. The horizon is implied by receding hills and distant structures. The style is detailed engraving with fine lines for textures and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with various shades of gray and earthy tones. People are depicted near a building, some engaged in activity. A pathway winds around rocky outcrops, leading to structures on the hills. Trees, rocks, and buildings blend into the environment, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Woodland Scene with Two Hunters and a Dog to the Left
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland scene with a slightly elevated vantage point. In the distance, there is a structure nestled among trees. The horizon is low and obscured by foliage and a slope. The artwork shows detailed, fine lines of trees, grass, and structures, resembling engravings. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of brown and gray. Two figures and a dog are in the left foreground, with trees framing the scene. In the background, birds are flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Head of an Apostle with Beard and Cap
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of an elderly man in profile facing left, with a downward gaze. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a wrinkled forehead, a long, pointed beard, and wears a fabric headpiece tied under his chin. The man is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with a high neckline that seems to be buttoned down the front. The background is a textured, lined surface without any distinct objects.

artworks.title: Pieter Brueghel, the Younger
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's partial portrait within an oval border. He has a stern expression, a long beard, and a receding hairline with short hair on top. His attire appears traditional or historical with a ruffled collar. Surrounding the oval frame are other figures, including one on the left holding a staff and one on the right blowing a trumpet. Above the portrait, a cherubic figure holds a compass, while below, a putto leans over a skull. The scene is set on an ornate base with intricate designs and a text inscription at the bottom, against a dark backdrop.

artworks.title: Le bal paré
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom scene. The image shows a ballroom filled with elegantly dressed figures. The hall is decorated with chandeliers, intricate moldings, curtains, and detailed wall paneling. Below the illustration, there is a decorative border with text mentioning "Le Bal" and Monsieur de Villemorien Fils.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Hans Leonard Schäufelein
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in the image. The first figure is seated on a chair partially hidden by curtains in an architectural setting with columns. This figure has long hair, wears flowing garments, and has decorative patterns. The second figure is in a dynamic position, gesturing with one hand while descending stairs. This figure has curly hair, wears a robe, and has wings. In the top right corner, there are cherubic faces among clouds. The background shows an interior with arches and designs, and a table with a pitcher in the foreground.

artworks.title: Le concert
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image displays numerous people seated indoors in an elaborate setting. The individuals are positioned in a circular manner around the room, with some engaged in conversation. They have carefully rendered facial features and wear 18th-century fashion, including ornate hairstyles and lavish clothing. The room is grand, with tall windows, columns, and classical decorations. A group at the far end of the room may be musicians or performers, but specific details are unclear. The background features a high, decorated ceiling, enhancing the luxurious atmosphere of the event.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.artist: Hans Leonard Schäufelein
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a man carrying a large cross surrounded by a crowd and a castle in the background. The artwork is a complex composition filled with intricate detail. The scene illustrates a narrative moment where a man is bent under the weight of a cross, with several figures around him wearing expressions that range from concern to indifference. The scene is bustling with activity, as soldiers in armor brandish weapons near the forefront. The architecture of a stone archway and the lush landscape with trees and a distant castle suggest the setting is both architectural and natural. The figures are dressed in garments that suggest historical European attire. The use of black and white and the style of cross-hatching give depth and texture to this illustrative work.

artworks.title: Christ Taken Prisoner
artworks.artist: Hans Leonard Schäufelein
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armed figures in intense interaction within a detailed natural and architectural backdrop. The figures are muscular and wield weapons such as swords and spears, conveying movement and tension. They have expressive faces and dynamic poses. In the background, there are rolling hills and a building atop a hill. The artwork showcases strong contrasts and bold lines, typical of Renaissance woodcut prints, emphasizing detail and expression. The use of light and shadow enhances the drama of the scene.

artworks.title: Mater Dolorosa and Saint Joseph
artworks.artist: Hans Leonard Schäufelein
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in full-length view, both standing side by side. The person on the left is positioned slightly angled towards the viewer, with a hand resting on their chest and holding a large sword. This person is wearing a hooded garment that wraps around the head, obscuring facial features except the relative position of the eyes can be discerned. The person on the right stands upright, with one hand clutching a stick or staff. This individual has a beard and curly hair, wearing a long robe that drapes over the body. The scene takes place under an ornate archway with detailed carvings at the top, and the background depicts a landscape with trees, hills, and a structure reminiscent of a castle or fortress on a hilltop. The setting appears to be outdoors, with the figures framed neatly by the architecture surrounding them.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Scolari
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a beard standing outdoors. He is holding a large cross-staff with one hand resting on his hip. The man is draped in a cloth covering one shoulder and the landscape around him includes rocky terrain, a lion at his feet, trees with intricate branches, a cloudy sky, a skull among tree roots, and a ladder leaning against the skull. The scene is illustrated in a style similar to an old engraving or woodcut.

artworks.title: Cottage and Harvesters
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a low vantage point. The horizon is situated at around one-third from the top, with rolling hills and a cluster of trees marking its boundary. On the horizon, there are large trees and a house outlined against the sky. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid. The color palette consists of muted grays and browns. Closest to the viewer, several figures can be seen working in a field surrounded by stacks of hay. To the right, beyond the figures, a series of trees lead toward a silhouetted house. In the distance, more hills are faintly visible under a sky with soft textures.

artworks.title: Kingston Bank, No.2
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with people on the river bank and a sailboat on the water. The horizon, marked by trees and a small settlement, is positioned in the upper third of the image. Figures on the left are engaged in various activities, including gathering water. On the right, a sailboat with figures on board floats on the water. The brushstrokes are smooth, creating a realistic texture. The sepia-toned palette adds a warm atmosphere. Light and shadow are used to create depth and highlight the human activities and serene setting.

artworks.title: The Timber Raft on the Rhine
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with a faint silhouette of land on the horizon. There is a dark form resembling a structure or rock formation near the viewer, with some shadowy figures nearby. The sky has dramatic swirling clouds, creating a moody atmosphere. The brushstrokes are soft, blending the elements in the sky and water. A subtle reflection is visible on the water's surface. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray.

artworks.title: The Snow Drift
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with snow-capped mountains in the distance under swirling clouds. Close by are trees with thick, gnarled trunks and branches, depicted with textured brushstrokes. In the foreground, two figures on horseback are traversing rough terrain. The palette is monochrome grayscale, creating a weighty and atmospheric mood with dark shadows contrasting against lighter areas.

artworks.title: A Sussex Down
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after John Constable
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is positioned lower in the composition, allowing for a vast expanse of sky to dominate the image. Two figures are depicted working on an open field. In the distance, a large windmill stands prominently on the horizon to the right, its sails juxtaposing against the sky, while another windmill is visible even further back on the right edge. The brushstrokes in the sky are smooth and sweeping, creating billowing clouds. The overall color palette consists of grayscale tones, emphasizing contrasts and textures, giving the scene a somber yet timeless quality.

artworks.title: A Yorkshire Road
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with distant hills on the horizon, a sloping land to the left, and a line of trees or shrubs in the middle against a cloudy sky. The sky has dynamic clouds in swirling brushstrokes, and a monochromatic color palette of gray contrasts lighter clouds with darker land below. There are indistinct vegetation shapes in the foreground, including a lighter patch that may represent a structure, with darker land merging with the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Hayfield in Yorkshire
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with various activities happening close by. People and animals, possibly cattle, are seen moving through a body of water while a cart is being pulled by horses. The scene is bustling with movement. Rolling hills are visible in the distance above the horizon. The sky is filled with fluffy clouds, allowing sunlight to stream down onto the landscape. The brushstrokes are soft and sweeping, giving a sense of fluidity and peace. The color palette is monochromatic with dark and light tones highlighting textures and elements, adding visual depth and dynamism to the piece.

artworks.title: Moonlight on a River
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water with a low horizon in the center. A tall silhouette, possibly a water tower or chimney, is prominent on the horizon. There are indistinct architectural forms to the right, potentially part of a bridge. The style features loose brushstrokes blending the scene elements, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. On the left, there are shadowy figures near a boat on the water. The cloudy sky fills the top, with a luminous full moon partly obscured by clouds, reflecting in the water and contributing to the somber mood.

artworks.title: A Roman Canal
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Peter De Wint
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a cloudy sky dominating the top part of the picture. A line of trees marks the horizon in the distance. Near the foreground, there is a path along a riverbank where figures and horses are loading hay onto a cart and a boat. The style is monochrome with detailed brushstrokes showcasing textures. The color palette consists of shades of gray and brown.

artworks.title: The Mouth of the Thames—Isle of Sheppey in Distance
artworks.artist: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the sea from a low vantage point just above the water. The horizon is low, with the sky dominating the upper part of the image. In the distance, several sailing ships are navigating the water, with their sails partially unfurled. The brushstrokes give a soft quality to the waves and ships. The color palette is sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere. The clouds are dense, giving an impression of impending weather contrasting with the lighter hues in the water.

artworks.title: The Mummer
artworks.artist: Joseph Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated, shown from the waist up. He has a prominent nose and a wrinkled face. His lips are closed, and he has a furrowed brow. The man wears a tall top hat casting a shadow over his face. He has a heavy coat and is holding a long, thin object, possibly a cane or walking stick. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Brangwyn
artworks.artist: Joseph Simpson
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man in a seated position, facing right. He has a beard, short hair, and is holding a brush in his right hand. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment and is surrounded by jars and containers. The background is plain.
